result.title: Conditional Generation of Creative Chess Puzzles with Diffusion Models
result.summary: While modern language models demonstrate impressive generative capabilities, they often struggle with constrained, counter-intuitive creative tasks. To address this limitation, we explore chess puzzle generation as a rigorous testbed for computational creativity and reasoning, a domain where altering a single piece can invalidate an entire solution. We propose a novel approach for conditional generation of creative chess puzzles using masked diffusion models. Unlike previous methods, our non-directional diffusion approach allows for conditioning on specific tactical themes and partial board positions. We introduce a novel auxiliary task of simultaneous best-move prediction, which improves solution uniqueness by 11.6% and theme-conditioning accuracy by 2.5%. To further optimize solution uniqueness and theme conditioning, we establish a reinforcement learning framework adapted from Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO). This RL training increases the yield of unique and theme-matching positions by 89.1%. Finally, we release the first open-weights models (Appendix B) for chess puzzle generation, offering a new pathway for controllable, creative generation.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文以国际象棋残局/谜题生成为受约束的创造性推理测试平台，提出基于掩码扩散模型的条件生成方法，可按战术主题和部分棋盘局面进行条件生成，并引入同时预测最佳着法的辅助任务与改编自 DDPO 的强化学习来提升解的唯一性与主题匹配度。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线的联系较间接，但「掩码扩散的条件生成 + 解唯一性/主题匹配的 RL 奖励」可能为 latent 推理中的状态生成方式、证据条件化与监督信号设计提供跨域线索，可供核查。
